# storybook-addon-vis and vitest-plugin-vis

> storybook-addon-vis: Storybook Vitest visual testing addon. vitest-plugin-vis: Vitest visual testing plugin. Image snapshot testing for Vitest browser mode, with a Storybook integration.

This file is generated by `packages/storybook-addon-vis/scripts/generate-llms-txt.mjs` from the packages' `exports` maps, their source, and the documentation pages. Do not edit it by hand; run `pnpm docs:llms` instead.

If an image snapshot test fails, read [Reviewing Failures with Agents](https://repobuddy.github.io/visual-testing/?path=/docs/reviewing-failures-with-agents--docs) before opening any image.

Image snapshots are stored in the repository under `__vis__/`. Within it, `__baselines__` holds the expected images, `__results__` holds the images from the latest run, and `__diffs__` holds the diff images of failed comparisons. Next to each diff image, `<name>.review.png` is the review image of the changed regions and `<name>.regions.json` lists those regions.

Import from the entry points listed below, not from package internals. Documentation pages list the names they cover; names without a page have only their type declarations.

## Start here

- [storybook-addon-vis: Reviewing Failures with Agents](https://repobuddy.github.io/visual-testing/?path=/docs/reviewing-failures-with-agents--docs): When an image snapshot fails, a coding agent often opens the baseline and the result and compares them.

## Packages

- [storybook-addon-vis](https://www.npmjs.com/package/storybook-addon-vis): Storybook Vitest visual testing addon. Peer dependencies: @storybook/addon-vitest ^10.1.10, @vitest/browser ^4, storybook ^10.1.10, vitest ^4.
- [vitest-plugin-vis](https://www.npmjs.com/package/vitest-plugin-vis): Vitest visual testing plugin. Peer dependencies: @vitest/browser ^4, @vitest/browser-playwright ^4 (optional), @vitest/browser-webdriverio ^4 (optional), vitest ^4.
